record: Introduced the bipartisan Doctors Not AI Act to keep AI from making health care decisions.
Introduced a bipartisan bill to ban non-disclosure agreements in AI data center deals with local officials.
Introduced a bill directing a National Academies study of the environmental effects of AI data centers (his third AI data center bill).
Wrote to Innovaccer calling for an end to AI-assisted Medicare prior authorization denials under the WISeR model.
grade_reason: In 2026 he spoke and legislated often about AI (AI denials in health care and Medicare, data center costs, transparency and pollution), but nothing found in his press releases or news coverage acknowledges catastrophic risk from AI.
